data.body: OPERATOR ACTION COMPLETE (2026-08-13): terraform apply executed from a worktree at merged origin/main (432a92c165). Deployed alarm aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.bridge_run_failures updated in-place: threshold 1 -> 0, evaluation_periods 1 -> 2, datapoints_to_alarm 1 -> 2 (fires on TWO CONSECUTIVE failed hours; a healthy pass publishes 0 and breaks the streak). Post-apply plan confirms 'No changes' — Terraform Drift is clear and bridge failures are alarmed again at the hourly cadence. Note: the first plan ran from the stale main checkout and falsely reported no drift; the retune only appears when planning from a tree containing 432a92c165.
